source_notes.takeaway: Codex CLI supports multiple approval modes and expects sandbox scope awareness; Windows support should be treated carefully and receipt-tested.
Local command execution should remain sandboxed or governed by strict allow/deny boundaries before forwarding commands.
Documentation-backed MCP surfaces can support source refresh, but connector use must keep authorization and publication boundaries explicit.

source_notes.source: Model Context Protocol security best practices
source_notes.takeaway: Consent, scoped authorization, state validation, and blast-radius reduction are central to safe tool and connector orchestration.
Authorization flows and dynamic client registration require careful scope handling and token-boundary discipline.
Logs and receipts should exclude secrets, session identifiers, access tokens, sensitive personal data, and raw internal paths unless explicitly justified and protected.
